### FMP-0001

**Adopt the protocol and ecosystem governance charter**

Adopt charter 1.0.0-rc.1: a protocol council, security response team, and appeals panel with seats reserved for independent implementers and community operators; published timelines for proposals, security decisions, appeals, and deprecation; conflict and funding disclosures linked to every decision; and rights that no plan, token, or funder can remove.

- Deciding body: protocol-council
- Authors: forkmesh-maintainers
- Disclosures: [DISC-0001](#disc-0001)
- Protected rights touched: free-protocol, portable-identity, portable-repositories, token-free-governance
- Timeline: opened 2026-09-14; reviewCloses 2026-10-14; lastCallCloses —; decided —; implemented —
- Votes: none recorded
- Dissent: solicited; none recorded
- [Issue #513](https://app.forkmesh.com/forkmesh/forkmesh/issues/513)
- [Charter guide](https://app.forkmesh.com/forkmesh/forkmesh/blob/main/www/docs/governance/README.md)

> The charter sets its own adoption review at the 30-day breaking-change minimum. It cannot be decided while the council has no independent-implementer or community-operator seat holder, because the quorum requires both.

### FMS-0001

**Block a stable protocol suite while any critical or high threat is open**

Pre-charter record of the stable release rule in the threat register: the suite stays a candidate until each critical or high threat is mitigated by a numbered requirement or accepted with a reviewer, date, and rationale. Open high threats at the time of recording: TM-004, TM-006, TM-008, TM-014, TM-018.

## Disclosures

### DISC-0001

Participant `forkmesh-maintainers`, filed 2026-09-14.

Conflicts:
- Maintain the reference Python, WebCrypto JavaScript, and clean-room Python implementations, and both registered certification adapters.
- Operate forkmesh.com, which sells Supporter and Pro memberships. A protocol decision that moves work onto or off the hosted service changes the operator's revenue.
- Maintain the desktop client and the headless mirror and gateway tools, which compete with independent implementations of the same roles.

| Funding kind | Source | Amount |
| --- | --- | --- |
| membership | Supporter and Pro memberships through Patreon | not published |
| donation | Solana donation addresses published on profiles and repositories | not published |
| reward-pool | Community reward pool, bounties, and microjob payouts, which maintainers may also claim as contributors | not published |

Linked records: [FMP-0000](#fmp-0000), [FMP-0001](#fmp-0001), [FMS-0001](#fms-0001).

> Amounts are not yet published. A disclosure with an unpublished amount keeps the funding closure criterion open.
